messages:
Zara Lim: hey everyone — accepted the org invite but I only see public repos. trying to open eng-serving/core and it 404s. also getting 'platform not supported' when GitHub offered passkey 2FA on my Pixel. who should I ping?

onboarding-bot: welcome Zara! :tada: Usually this is SSO or membership type. Check docs: https://docs.redwood.example/devex/github-access. @DevEx-Pete can triage.

DevEx-Pete: @Zara Lim what's your GitHub handle?

Zara Lim: zlim123

DevEx-Pete: I see you accepted but your membership type is "outside collaborator" and sso_required: true. Two quick fixes: add your work email to GitHub and verify it, or we convert you to a member and re-trigger SSO. Want me to convert?

Zara Lim: please convert — added work email already and still outside.

IT-Rina: converting now and sending SAML authorization. FYI Pixel webauthn/passkey can be flaky on older Android; recommend enrolling TOTP or requesting a YubiKey if you want hardware keys.

Zara Lim: got the IdP email and started SSO, GitHub asked me to enroll a passkey which failed. I enrolled TOTP instead and completed SSO.

SRE-Jules: added Zara to eng-serving-dev with write. Propagation may take a minute. If you still see 404 after SSO, try logout + incognito + re-login.

Zara Lim: did incognito + re-login, can view repo now but push gives 403: "Permission to redwood-inference/eng-serving/core.git denied to zlim123."

Marcus: I granted repo write and team membership. 403 after team add is usually cached credentials — what OS/credential helper are you on?

Zara Lim: macOS, using osxkeychain.

DevEx-Pete: run `git credential-osxkeychain erase` then `gh auth login` — that clears cached tokens.

Zara Lim: erased and re-auth'd, push succeeded. thanks!

IT-Rina: I've filed IT ticket RW-978 to provision a YubiKey for Zara and to note the passkey/platform issue in onboarding. If you want a YubiKey, reply to the ticket with shipping address.

Zara Lim: will do, thanks everyone. quick Q — where's the onboarding doc listing default teams?

DevEx-Pete: https://docs.redwood.example/people/onboarding — default teams by role. Welcome aboard! :wave:

Zara Lim: awesome, really appreciate the quick help :smile:
